backwater-bayou-0.24.1 |location33 = Jerry's Workshop }} '''Surveillance Goons''' were [[NPCs]] located near the entrance of every island when the {{AN|Public Surveillance}} perk is chosen by an elected minister when {{NPCSprite|Candidate Aura;Aura}} was mayor. They were initially introduced as part of {{rn|YouTube|Candypat}}'s {{AN|Public Surveillance}} perk and required players to check in every {{Green|30}} minutes. Failing to do so granted a {{Red|10%}} stat debuff. The duration was later increased to {{Green|12}} hours and added as part of {{rn|MVP+|MelonKingDe}}'s Minister perks. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" |Checking in |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Goon&f: Aura thanks you for your cooperation.
